desc: Parse input: read N and the list S; build a 0/1 indicator array f of size M+1 where M = max(S).
Compute the convolution c = f * f using FFT (numpy rfft/irfft) with length L = next power of two ≥ 2M+1; pure-Python NTT fallback (mod 998244353) if numpy is missing.
Round the inverse FFT real parts to nearest integers to get c[k] = number of ordered pairs (x, y) ∈ S² with x + y = k.
For each B in S, count unordered pairs {A, C} with A + C = 2B, A < C as (c[2B] - 1) // 2 (subtract self-pair (B, B), halve ordered count).
Sum over all B ∈ S and print the total.
Implement the full program with fast I/O (sys.stdin.buffer.read), numpy FFT path, and NTT fallback.
Verify edge cases and correctness: N < 3 → 0; sample 1 gives 3 (B=2,3,5 each contribute 1); FFT size ≥ 2M+1; coefficients ≤ 10^6 ≪ 2^53 so rounding is safe.
